correctness.rationale: Pointwise minimality follows from forced 0/1 labels outside the 2-defender set and an open private-zero neighbor for every defender. Cyclic gaps have no adjacent short gaps. The transfer matrix [[L,S],[L,0]] with L=x^3 z^2/(1-xz), S=z^2(x+x^2) yields the displayed trace-log generating function, with n/k counting labelled cycles including periodic words. All-long constructions realize weights n-j, 0<=j<=floor(n/3). Independent full enumeration of all 3^n functions for 3<=n<=8 matched the rational polynomial coefficients; finite cases corroborate, the gap proof supplies all n.
